name: English - Cultural Studies Joint Honours Component

rules.title: In addition to the 6-credit requirement for Advanced Study described below, all Joint Honours students' programs of study shall include 6 credits of study at the 400 level or above
In addition to the Advanced Study requirement, 3 of the remaining 21 Complementary Course credits must be completed at the 500 level
A maximum of 9 of the 27 credits are allowed at the 200 level, none in the final year of the program
6 credits of advanced study, in one of the following two forms A or B, in order of preference
B) Two 3-credit 500-level courses selected in consultation with the student's adviser(s)
For example, Joint Honours with Anthropology allows the option of combining 3 credits of essay work with 3 credits in the joint subject to create a joint essay.)
3 credits from a list of courses on Major Figures in Cultural Studies
3 credits of Theory, Criticism, and Methods courses from the complementary list or with the permission of your department adviser
3 credits from a list of courses in Cultural Studies with an historical dimension
3 credits from a list of 400-level courses in Cultural Studies with a theoretical component
9 additional credits of English (ENGL) courses, preferably courses at the 300 level or above
